diagnosis: Right breast IDC (infiltrating ductal carcinoma), grade 2, 18 mm, clear margins.
stage: T1c N0 M0, AJCC stage IA.
biology: ER+/PR+ luminal disease. HER2 1+ by IHC which counts as HER2-low, i.e. HER2 negative for adjuvant purposes.
genomic_risk: Oncotype DX RS of 14 places her in the low-risk group.
chemotherapy_decision: Skip chemo. With RS 14, node-negative disease and postmenopausal status, chemotherapy adds no benefit; endocrine therapy alone is appropriate.
endocrine_therapy: Start letrozole daily, planned for five years, with consideration of extension to 10 years.
radiotherapy: She should receive whole breast radiation following breast-conserving surgery.
supportive_monitoring: Get a bone density scan at baseline and supplement calcium/vitamin D.
